name: Update Worksheet Tablerow
description: Update the properties of tablerow object. `(Only for work or school account)` [See the documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/tablerow-update?view=graph-rest-1.0&tabs=http)

configurable_props.name: folderId
configurable_props.label: Folder ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the folder where the item is located

configurable_props.name: sheetId
configurable_props.label: Sheet ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the spreadsheet you want to use

configurable_props.name: tableId
configurable_props.label: Table ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the table you want to use

configurable_props.name: rowId
configurable_props.label: Row ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the row you want to use

configurable_props.name: values
configurable_props.label: Values
configurable_props.description: An array of values for the updated row. Each item in the array represents one cell. E.g. `[1, 2, 3]`
